This is one concept (influential points) with a couple of reasoning steps and no heavy computation or reading. It is a typical AP exam-style item, neither basic recall nor advanced.

answers.brief_reasoning: The other points have a slope of about 3.6, which predicts about 140 mpg at x=33.4. The point is at 96.5, well below the trend, so it flattens the line and weakens r. Removing it makes the slope steeper and r stronger.
